title: Wedding Teasing
synopsis: Have you heard of the Chinese custom of teasing bridegrooms and brides when they get married?

fullText.simplified:
变了味的婚闹

    婚闹，是中国传统的婚俗，包括“闹新娘”、“闹洞房”等。
    在古代，中国人通常是盲婚哑嫁，新郎新娘在结婚前很少有来往，甚至连面都没有见过。新郎新娘在结婚的时候才第一次见到对方，都不知道怎么跨越僵持尴尬的气氛去亲近对方，这时候，闹洞房就发挥了作用。“闹洞房”就是来参加婚礼的客人们会要求新郎新娘互相配合做一些事情，这些事情要依赖对方、互相配合才能完成。新郎新娘要按照客人们的要求做，不能生气。于是，新郎新娘不得已，只能亲近对方，半推半就，按照客人们的要求做。人们通过闹洞房的方式，让新郎新娘在不尴尬的气氛中熟悉对方，能帮助他们尽快进入夫妻的角色。
    婚闹是为了增加喜庆气氛，出发点本来是好的，但如今却变了味，出现了很多非常离谱的婚闹行为，有的婚闹甚至闹出了官司，闹出了人命。比如，有些地方以“闹新郎”为主，他们让新郎倒立着，然后用胶带绑在树上。他们会往新郎身上扔鸡蛋、倒水、倒啤酒，还会在新郎旁边放鞭炮等；有些地方甚至会“闹伴娘”，把伴娘扔到河里，脱伴娘的衣服、内裤等。
    民俗专家呼吁，不要让婚闹这个习俗变成恶俗！结婚是个喜庆事儿，婚闹只是为了增加喜庆气氛，不应该不顾新郎、新娘的意愿，以婚闹之名，做出一些伤风败俗，违法乱纪的事。
fullText.traditional:
變了味的婚鬧

    婚鬧，是中國傳統的婚俗，包括“鬧新娘”、“鬧洞房”等。
    在古代，中國人通常是盲婚啞嫁，新郎新娘在結婚前很少有來往，甚至連面都沒有見過。新郎新娘在結婚的時候才第一次見到對方，都不知道怎麼跨越僵持尷尬的氣氛去親近對方，這時候，鬧洞房就發揮了作用。“鬧洞房”就是來參加婚禮的客人們會要求新郎新娘互相配合做一些事情，這些事情要依賴對方、互相配合才能完成。新郎新娘要按照客人們的要求做，不能生氣。於是，新郎新娘不得已，只能親近對方，半推半就，按照客人們的要求做。人們通過鬧洞房的方式，讓新郎新娘在不尷尬的氣氛中熟悉對方，能幫助他們盡快進入夫妻的角色。
    婚鬧是為了增加喜慶氣氛，出發點本來是好的，但如今卻變了味，出現了很多非常離譜的婚鬧行為，有的婚鬧甚至鬧出了官司，鬧出了人命。比如，有些地方以“鬧新郎”為主，他們讓新郎倒立著，然後用膠帶綁在樹上。他們會往新郎身上扔雞蛋、倒水、倒啤酒，還會在新郎旁邊放鞭炮等；有些地方甚至會“鬧伴娘”，把伴娘扔到河裡，脫伴娘的衣服、內褲等。
    民俗專家呼籲，不要讓婚鬧這個習俗變成惡俗！結婚是個喜慶事兒，婚鬧只是為了增加喜慶氣氛，不應該不顧新郎、新娘的意願，以婚鬧之名，做出一些傷風敗俗，違法亂紀的事。

sentences.english: Changed Flavor of Wedding Teasing

sentences.simplified: 婚闹，是中国传统的婚俗，包括“闹新娘”、“闹洞房”等。
sentences.traditional: 婚鬧，是中國傳統的婚俗，包括“鬧新娘”、“鬧洞房”等。
sentences.pinyin: hūn nào shì zhōng guó chuán tǒng de hūn sú bāo kuò nào xīn niáng nào dòng fáng děng

sentences.english: Wedding teasing is a traditional Chinese marriage custom that includes “tease the bride”, “tease the newly-weds”, etc.

sentences.simplified: 在古代，中国人通常是盲婚哑嫁，
sentences.traditional: 在古代，中國人通常是盲婚啞嫁，
sentences.pinyin: zài gǔ dài zhōng guó rén tōng cháng shì máng hūn yǎ jià

sentences.simplified: 新郎新娘在结婚前很少有来往，
sentences.traditional: 新郎新娘在結婚前很少有來往，
sentences.pinyin: xīn láng xīn niáng zài jié hūn qián hěn shǎo yǒu lái wǎng
sentences.english: In ancient times, Chinese people usually had arranged marriages.

sentences.simplified: 甚至连面都没有见过。
sentences.traditional: 甚至連面都沒有見過。
sentences.pinyin: shèn zhì lián miàn dōu méi yǒu jiàn guò
sentences.english: It was rare that the bridegroom and bride had been in contact before they got married, ..

sentences.simplified: 新郎新娘在结婚的时候才第一次见到对方，
sentences.traditional: 新郎新娘在結婚的時候才第一次見到對方，
sentences.pinyin: xīn láng xīn niáng zài jié hūn de shí hou cái dì yī cì jiàn dào duì fāng
sentences.english: .. to the extent that they hadn’t even seen each other’s faces.

sentences.simplified: 都不知道怎么跨越僵持尴尬的气氛去亲近对方，
sentences.traditional: 都不知道怎麼跨越僵持尷尬的氣氛去親近對方，
sentences.pinyin: dōu bù zhī dào zěn me kuà yuè jiāng chí gān gà de qì fēn qù qīn jìn duì fāng
sentences.english: Not until when the bridegroom and bride were getting married did they see the other for the first time.

sentences.simplified: 这时候，闹洞房就发挥了作用。
sentences.traditional: 這時候，鬧洞房就發揮了作用。
sentences.pinyin: zhè shí hou nào dòng fáng jiù fā huī le zuò yòng
sentences.english: Neither would know how to get close to the other and get over the deadlock of awkward atmosphere.

sentences.simplified: “闹洞房”就是来参加婚礼的客人们会要求
sentences.traditional: “鬧洞房”就是來參加婚禮的客人們會要求
sentences.pinyin: nào dòng fáng jiù shì lái cān jiā hūn lǐ de kè rén men huì yāo qiú
sentences.english: At this time, teasing the newly-weds comes into effect.

sentences.simplified: 新郎新娘互相配合做一些事情，
sentences.traditional: 新郎新娘互相配合做一些事情，
sentences.pinyin: xīn láng xīn niáng hù xiāng pèi hé zuò yì xiē shì qing
sentences.english: “Tease the newly-weds” is when the guests that are taking part in the wedding will request ..

sentences.simplified: 这些事情要依赖对方、互相配合才能完成。
sentences.traditional: 這些事情要依賴對方、互相配合才能完成。
sentences.pinyin: zhè xiē shì qing yào yī lài duì fāng hù xiāng pèi hé cái néng wán chéng
sentences.english: .. that the bridegroom and bride work in coordination to do a few things.

sentences.simplified: 新郎新娘要按照客人们的要求做，不能生气。
sentences.traditional: 新郎新娘要按照客人們的要求做，不能生氣。
sentences.pinyin: xīn láng xīn niáng yào àn zhào kè rén men de yāo qiú zuò bù néng shēng qì
sentences.english: These things require that they rely on each other and cooperate to be able to complete.

sentences.simplified: 于是，新郎新娘不得已，只能亲近对方，
sentences.traditional: 於是，新郎新娘不得已，只能親近對方，
sentences.pinyin: yú shì xīn láng xīn niáng bù dé yǐ zhǐ néng qīn jìn duì fāng
sentences.english: The bridegroom and bride must act according to the guests’ requirements, without getting angry.

sentences.simplified: 半推半就，按照客人们的要求做。
sentences.traditional: 半推半就，按照客人們的要求做。
sentences.pinyin: bàn tuī bàn jiù àn zhào kè rén men de yāo qiú zuò
sentences.english: As a result, the bridegroom and bride have no choice, and have to get close to each other, ..

sentences.simplified: 人们通过闹洞房的方式，让新郎新娘在不尴尬的气氛中熟悉对方，
sentences.traditional: 人們通過鬧洞房的方式，讓新郎新娘在不尷尬的氣氛中熟悉對方，
sentences.pinyin: rén men tōng guò nào dòng fáng de fāng shì ràng xīn láng xīn niáng zài bù gān gà de qì fēn zhōng shú xī duì fāng
sentences.english: .. yielding after making a show of resistance, and act according to the guests’ requirements.

sentences.simplified: 能帮助他们尽快进入夫妻的角色。
sentences.traditional: 能幫助他們盡快進入夫妻的角色。
sentences.pinyin: néng bāng zhù tā men jǐn kuài jìn rù fū qī de jué sè
sentences.english: People’s use of teasing the newly-weds to have the bridegroom and bride get familiar with each other in a non-awkward atmosphere, ..
.. can help them get into the roles of husband and wife as quickly as possible.

sentences.simplified: 婚闹是为了增加喜庆气氛，出发点本来是好的，
sentences.traditional: 婚鬧是為了增加喜慶氣氛，出發點本來是好的，
sentences.pinyin: hūn nào shì wèi le zēng jiā xǐ qìng qì fēn chū fā diǎn běn lái shì hǎo de

sentences.simplified: 但如今却变了味，出现了很多非常离谱的婚闹行为，
sentences.traditional: 但如今卻變了味，出現了很多非常離譜的婚鬧行為，
sentences.pinyin: dàn rú jīn què biàn le wèi chū xiàn le hěn duō fēi cháng lí pǔ de hūn nào xíng wéi
sentences.english: Wedding teasing is for the sake of adding to the joyous atmosphere and started out as something good.

sentences.simplified: 有的婚闹甚至闹出了官司，闹出了人命。
sentences.traditional: 有的婚鬧甚至鬧出了官司，鬧出了人命。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu de hūn nào shèn zhì nào chū le guān si nào chū le rén mìng
sentences.english: But now there has been a change of flavor and has appeared a lot of wedding teasing behavior that goes way too far.

sentences.simplified: 比如，有些地方以“闹新郎”为主，
sentences.traditional: 比如，有些地方以“鬧新郎”為主，
sentences.pinyin: bǐ rú yǒu xiē dì fāng yǐ nào xīn láng wéi zhǔ
sentences.english: Some wedding teasing has even teased up lawsuits and resulted in the loss of human lives.

sentences.simplified: 他们让新郎倒立着，然后用胶带绑在树上。
sentences.traditional: 他們讓新郎倒立著，然後用膠帶綁在樹上。
sentences.pinyin: tā men ràng xīn láng dào lì zhe rán hòu yòng jiāo dài bǎng zài shù shang
sentences.english: For example, in some places they mainly “tease the bridegroom”.

sentences.simplified: 他们会往新郎身上扔鸡蛋、倒水、倒啤酒，
sentences.traditional: 他們會往新郎身上扔雞蛋、倒水、倒啤酒，
sentences.pinyin: tā men huì wǎng xīn láng shēn shang rēng jī dàn dào shuǐ dào pí jiǔ
sentences.english: They make the bridegroom stand upside down and then tie him up to a tree using adhesive tape.

sentences.simplified: 还会在新郎旁边放鞭炮等；
sentences.traditional: 還會在新郎旁邊放鞭炮等；
sentences.pinyin: hái huì zài xīn láng páng biān fàng biān pào děng
sentences.english: They will then throw eggs, pour water, and pour beer on the bridegroom’s body, ..

sentences.simplified: 有些地方甚至会“闹伴娘”，
sentences.traditional: 有些地方甚至會“鬧伴娘”，
sentences.pinyin: yǒu xiē dì fāng shèn zhì huì nào bàn niáng
sentences.english: .. as well as set off firecrackers next to the bridegroom, and so on;

sentences.simplified: 把伴娘扔到河里，脱伴娘的衣服、内裤等。
sentences.traditional: 把伴娘扔到河裡，脫伴娘的衣服、內褲等。
sentences.pinyin: bǎ bàn niáng rēng dào hé lǐ tuō bàn niáng de yī fu nèi kù děng
sentences.english: In some places, they even go as far as to “tease the bridesmaid”.
They take a bridesmaid and throw her in a river, take off the bridesmaid’s clothes, panties and so on.

sentences.simplified: 民俗专家呼吁，不要让婚闹这个习俗变成恶俗！
sentences.traditional: 民俗專家呼籲，不要讓婚鬧這個習俗變成惡俗！
sentences.pinyin: mín sú zhuān jiā hū yù bú yào ràng hūn nào zhè ge xí sú biàn chéng è sú

sentences.simplified: 结婚是个喜庆事儿，婚闹只是为了增加喜庆气氛，
sentences.traditional: 結婚是個喜慶事兒，婚鬧只是為了增加喜慶氣氛，
sentences.pinyin: jié hūn shì ge xǐ qìng shì'r hūn nào zhǐ shì wèi le zēng jiā xǐ qìng qì fēn
sentences.english: Folk custom experts appeal not to let this custom of wedding teasing change into an evil custom!

sentences.simplified: 不应该不顾新郎、新娘的意愿，
sentences.traditional: 不應該不顧新郎、新娘的意願，
sentences.pinyin: bù yīng gāi bú gù xīn láng xīn niáng de yì yuàn
sentences.english: Getting married is a joyful matter and wedding teasing is just for the sake of adding joy to the atmosphere,

sentences.simplified: 以婚闹之名，做出一些伤风败俗，违法乱纪的事。
sentences.traditional: 以婚鬧之名，做出一些傷風敗俗，違法亂紀的事。
sentences.pinyin: yǐ hūn nào zhī míng zuò chū yì xiē shāng fēng bài sú wéi fǎ luàn jì de shì
sentences.english: It shouldn’t be in spite of the bridegroom’s and bride’s wishes, ..
.. and in the name of wedding teasing, doing things that violate common decency and break the law.

sentence_translations: Changed Flavor of Wedding Teasing
Wedding teasing is a traditional Chinese marriage custom that includes “tease the bride”, “tease the newly-weds”, etc.
In ancient times, Chinese people usually had arranged marriages.
It was rare that the bridegroom and bride had been in contact before they got married, ..
.. to the extent that they hadn’t even seen each other’s faces.
Not until when the bridegroom and bride were getting married did they see the other for the first time.
Neither would know how to get close to the other and get over the deadlock of awkward atmosphere.
At this time, teasing the newly-weds comes into effect.
“Tease the newly-weds” is when the guests that are taking part in the wedding will request ..
.. that the bridegroom and bride work in coordination to do a few things.
These things require that they rely on each other and cooperate to be able to complete.
The bridegroom and bride must act according to the guests’ requirements, without getting angry.
As a result, the bridegroom and bride have no choice, and have to get close to each other, ..
.. yielding after making a show of resistance, and act according to the guests’ requirements.
People’s use of teasing the newly-weds to have the bridegroom and bride get familiar with each other in a non-awkward atmosphere, ..
.. can help them get into the roles of husband and wife as quickly as possible.
Wedding teasing is for the sake of adding to the joyous atmosphere and started out as something good.
But now there has been a change of flavor and has appeared a lot of wedding teasing behavior that goes way too far.
Some wedding teasing has even teased up lawsuits and resulted in the loss of human lives.
For example, in some places they mainly “tease the bridegroom”.
They make the bridegroom stand upside down and then tie him up to a tree using adhesive tape.
They will then throw eggs, pour water, and pour beer on the bridegroom’s body, ..
.. as well as set off firecrackers next to the bridegroom, and so on;
In some places, they even go as far as to “tease the bridesmaid”.
They take a bridesmaid and throw her in a river, take off the bridesmaid’s clothes, panties and so on.
Folk custom experts appeal not to let this custom of wedding teasing change into an evil custom!
Getting married is a joyful matter and wedding teasing is just for the sake of adding joy to the atmosphere,
It shouldn’t be in spite of the bridegroom’s and bride’s wishes, ..
.. and in the name of wedding teasing, doing things that violate common decency and break the law.
